name: Finitum Bridge
description_short: Cross-chain bridge between Cardano and BSC.
description_long: Custodial cross-chain bridge for moving supported tokens between Cardano and BNB Chain using a lock-mint-burn-unlock mechanism. BEP20 tokens are locked in a smart contract on BSC and a corresponding Cardano native token is minted; burning the Cardano side unlocks and returns the original asset. Supported tokens are BUSD, UMB, BHC, and HPS. Built by the Staking Rocks! [PHRCK] stake pool, originally to distribute Umbrella Network validator rewards to Cardano delegators.
